oracle.invariant: Exit code 0, 0 failures, 0 skipped. '#806 F-S8-003: the served badge with no data-origin opens Tracy production' passes: /tracy-badge.js as served, run on a JoomlArt demo page from a tag with no data-origin (and one with an empty data-origin), draws a.cta with href https://cowork.tracy.ai/design-inspiration?open=ja-kinetic&provider=JoomlArt, and the served bytes do not contain https://cowork.tracy.site. '#806 F-S8-003: the link helper and the snippet default to Tracy production' passes: DEFAULT_TRACY_ORIGIN is https://cowork.tracy.ai; badgeHref with no origin, an empty one or one no URL can be built from uses it; badgeSnippet with no origin writes data-origin="https://cowork.tracy.ai". '#806 F-S8-003: the two advert scripts agree on the default origin' passes: lib/tracy-badge.js and lib/build-with-tracy-demo.js export the same DEFAULT_TRACY_ORIGIN. '#806 F-S8-003: a deployment with no configured origin documents and links production' passes: GET /tracy-badge with no config.origin names https://cowork.tracy.ai in the script src, data-origin and the documented default. '#806 F-S1-011: a signed-in GET /<label>/join answers 200 with the page of each state' passes: status 200 and no Allow header for no account, no grant, a pending request, an invitation, an accepted membership, a revoked grant and a declined grant, each with the form that state has always drawn. 'an explicit development origin still wins over the default' passes: data-origin="https://cowork.tracy.site" yields a https://cowork.tracy.site link. 'a join GET only reads: three exact queries at most, no write, no mail' passes; 'no session, a forged one or an expired one: the join page still redirects to sign-in' passes with 303 to /login; 'an unknown, malformed or reserved label is still a 404, signed in or not' passes. 'the three badge scripts leave this app with a five-minute public cache' passes: /badge.js, /tracy-badge.js and /build-with-tracy-demo.js carry cache-control 'public, max-age=300' as this app sends them.
